capabilities.name: Multi-digit column arithmetic with regrouping and remainders
capabilities.name_zh: 多位数竖式笔算与带余除法
capabilities.description: Execute standard multi-digit column addition, subtraction, multi-digit by one-digit multiplication, and division with remainders, stating the place-value meaning of each step.

capabilities.name: Additive grouping and complementation
capabilities.name_zh: 加减凑整与带符号搬家
capabilities.description: Simplify multi-term addition and subtraction expressions by rearranging terms with their signs, grouping complementary pairs to tens, hundreds, or thousands, and removing/adding brackets.

capabilities.name: Benchmark product factorization and associative grouping
capabilities.name_zh: 乘法基准数凑整与分组结合
capabilities.description: Identify and exploit benchmark products such as 4 x 25 = 100 and 8 x 125 = 1000 by decomposing factors and applying the associative property of multiplication.

capabilities.name: Expanding via distributive law
capabilities.name_zh: 乘法分配律展开
capabilities.description: Multiply a single number across a sum or difference, particularly rewriting numbers near powers of ten as (100 +/- d) to compute products quickly.

capabilities.name: Factoring out common multipliers
capabilities.name_zh: 乘法分配律逆用（提取公因数）
capabilities.description: Identify shared factors across multiple product terms and factor them out to sum or subtract the remaining terms into round numbers.

capabilities.name: Constructing common multipliers across terms
capabilities.name_zh: 构造公因数巧算
capabilities.description: Transfer factors between numbers (e.g., 3 x 810 = 30 x 81) or split a term to reveal a hidden common factor for distributive calculation.

capabilities.name: Distributive division over addition and subtraction
capabilities.name_zh: 除法分配律与连续除法性质
capabilities.description: Distribute a single divisor across grouped summands (e.g., (4500 + 450 + 45) / 45) and transform chained division a / b / c into a / (b x c).

capabilities.name: Evaluating defined operations
capabilities.name_zh: 定义新运算直接代入与多层嵌套
capabilities.description: Substitute numerical operands into arbitrary teacher-defined symbolic formulas and evaluate single or nested operations following standard order of evaluation.

capabilities.name: Inverse solving of defined operations
capabilities.name_zh: 定义新运算逆运算求解
capabilities.description: Solve for an unknown variable embedded inside an equation featuring defined operations by working backwards from the output.

capabilities.name: Comprehensive rapid arithmetic calculation
capabilities.name_zh: 综合速算与巧算能力
capabilities.description: Inspect complex multi-operation arithmetic expressions, select the optimal calculation strategy, and execute error-free evaluation using arithmetic laws.

capabilities.name: Identifying arithmetic progression parameters
capabilities.name_zh: 识别等差数列基本要素
capabilities.description: Verify whether a number sequence is an arithmetic progression and identify its first term, last term, and common difference.

capabilities.name: Finding the n-th term of an arithmetic sequence
capabilities.name_zh: 求等差数列的第n项
capabilities.description: Calculate the value of the n-th term using the first term, the common difference, and the number of steps (n - 1).

capabilities.name: Finding the number of terms in an arithmetic sequence
capabilities.name_zh: 求等差数列的项数
capabilities.description: Determine the total count of terms in a finite arithmetic sequence using the formula (last - first) / difference + 1.

capabilities.name: Summing arithmetic sequences
capabilities.name_zh: 等差数列求和公式应用
capabilities.description: Calculate the sum of an arithmetic progression using the paired summation formula (first + last) x count / 2.

capabilities.name: Solving context problems involving arithmetic progressions
capabilities.name_zh: 等差数列综合与应用题
capabilities.description: Model word problems (such as ranked test scores or tiered quantities) as arithmetic sequences to determine unknown individual terms or sums.

capabilities.name: Divisibility tests for composite numbers
capabilities.name_zh: 数的整除特征判定（含综合整除）
capabilities.description: Apply divisibility criteria for 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, and 9 individually and combine them to determine unknown digits for composite divisors such as 36.

capabilities.name: Parity analysis of arithmetic operations
capabilities.name_zh: 奇数与偶数的运算性质分析
capabilities.description: Determine the parity of sums, differences, and products without evaluating full numbers, and apply parity invariants to prove existence or impossibility.

capabilities.name: Representing quantitative relationships using line segment diagrams
capabilities.name_zh: 画线段图表征数量关系
capabilities.description: Translate verbal descriptions of differences, sums, and multiples into accurate line segment diagrams representing baseline units.

capabilities.name: Solving standard sum-difference problems
capabilities.name_zh: 标准和差问题求解
capabilities.description: Calculate two unknown quantities given their total sum and difference using equalizing transformations or the sum-difference formulas.

capabilities.name: Solving standard sum-multiple problems
capabilities.name_zh: 标准和倍问题求解
capabilities.description: Identify the base unit quantity (1 unit) and solve for parts given the total sum and the multiple relationship between them.

capabilities.name: Solving advanced sum-multiple problems with offsets
capabilities.name_zh: 几倍多几/几倍少几的和倍问题
capabilities.description: Adjust the overall sum by adding or subtracting non-proportional remainders to restore strict integer multiple ratios before dividing by total units.

capabilities.name: Solving standard difference-multiple problems
capabilities.name_zh: 标准差倍问题求解
capabilities.description: Calculate quantities when given their difference and multiple ratio using the relationship difference / (multiple - 1) = 1 unit.

capabilities.name: Applying the constant-difference principle to changing quantities
capabilities.name_zh: 差不变原理在差倍问题中的应用
capabilities.description: Recognize that subtracting or adding equal amounts to two quantities preserves their difference, and use this invariant to solve dynamic multiple problems.

capabilities.name: Solving multi-party sum and difference multiple systems
capabilities.name_zh: 三个及以上对象的多重和差倍问题
capabilities.description: Express three or more related quantities in terms of a single benchmark unit and adjust surplus/deficit values to find all quantities simultaneously.

capabilities.name: Solving age problems using invariant age difference
capabilities.name_zh: 年龄差不变与动态倍数问题
capabilities.description: Calculate past, present, or future ages by enforcing the invariant property that the difference between two persons' ages never changes across time.

capabilities.name: Solving multi-person combined age changes across time
capabilities.name_zh: 多人多时段年龄和与倍数综合问题
capabilities.description: Track how the sum of multiple people's ages changes across years and align compound age conditions to solve for individual ages.

capabilities.name: Solving standard chicken-rabbit problems via hypothesis
capabilities.name_zh: 假设法解标准鸡兔同笼问题
capabilities.description: Assume all animals are of one kind, calculate the total difference from the actual head/leg counts, and divide by the difference per unit to determine the two populations.

capabilities.name: Solving grouped and packaged chicken-rabbit variants
capabilities.name_zh: 分组打包法解鸡兔同笼及拓展题
capabilities.description: Pair items with differing attributes (e.g., table tennis singles and doubles, multi-denomination stamps) into fixed packages to resolve surplus/deficit conditions.

capabilities.name: Differentiating tree-planting boundary configurations
capabilities.name_zh: 识别植树问题的三种端点情形
capabilities.description: Identify whether an open-line tree-planting problem has both ends planted, one end planted, or neither end planted, and relate count to intervals accordingly.

capabilities.name: Calculating intervals and distance in open tree-planting
capabilities.name_zh: 直线植树问题的距离与棵数计算
capabilities.description: Convert between total route length, interval spacing, and tree count across various boundary conditions.

capabilities.name: Solving closed-loop and variant interval problems
capabilities.name_zh: 封闭路线植树及楼梯锯木等类比模型
capabilities.description: Solve interval problems on closed loops (where tree count equals interval count) and analogize to climbing stairs, sawing logs, and ringing bells.

capabilities.name: Calculating counts in solid square formations
capabilities.name_zh: 实心方阵的边长与总数计算
capabilities.description: Relate the number of items per side, total items (n x n), and the outer perimeter layer count (4n - 4) for solid square arrays.

capabilities.name: Calculating nested layers in hollow square formations
capabilities.name_zh: 空心方阵的层数与增减变化计算
capabilities.description: Compute the number of items in single or multi-layered hollow square formations and calculate changes when adding or removing surrounding layers.

capabilities.name: Tracing single-track reverse operations
capabilities.name_zh: 单线倒推法（还原问题）
capabilities.description: Reconstruct an original starting number by systematically applying inverse operations in reverse chronological order from the final outcome.

capabilities.name: Working backwards with fractions and fractional offsets
capabilities.name_zh: 含“一半多/少几个”的还原问题
capabilities.description: Use flow diagrams or line segments to reconstruct original quantities when successive steps take a fractional part (such as half) plus or minus a constant offset.

capabilities.name: Solving multi-party mutual transfer problems with constant sum
capabilities.name_zh: 和不变的多人多次相互给移还原问题
capabilities.description: Construct backwards step tables to track quantities across multiple sequential transfers where the total sum remains constant.

capabilities.name: Identifying the cycle length in periodic sequences
capabilities.name_zh: 寻找周期规律与确定周期长度
capabilities.description: Examine repeating sequences of shapes, colors, letters, or digits to define the fundamental repeating unit and count its length.

capabilities.name: Determining the n-th element of a periodic sequence using division remainders
capabilities.name_zh: 余数法确定周期中的第n个对象
capabilities.description: Divide the target position n by the period length and interpret the quotient (completed cycles) and remainder to identify the specific item.

capabilities.name: Cumulative counting of specific items across multiple periods
capabilities.name_zh: 周期中特定对象的累计出现次数计算
capabilities.description: Compute how many times a particular element or sub-pattern occurs across n positions by multiplying occurrences per cycle by full cycles and adding remainder contributions.

capabilities.name: Solving calendar and day-of-week periodic problems
capabilities.name_zh: 日期与星期中的周期问题
capabilities.description: Calculate elapsed calendar days across months or years, modulo by 7, and determine target days of the week.

capabilities.name: Multi-sequence synchronized period matching
capabilities.name_zh: 多周期同步循环与同列对齐问题
capabilities.description: Analyze two or more cyclic text or number sequences operating in parallel to determine the elements aligned at any given position.

capabilities.name: Applying basic motion relationship s = v x t
capabilities.name_zh: 行程基本公式运用与时间单位换算
capabilities.description: Solve for speed, time, or distance given the other two parameters, performing required conversions between seconds, minutes, and hours.

capabilities.name: Solving opposite-direction separation problems
capabilities.name_zh: 同地出发反向相离行程问题
capabilities.description: Calculate the total separation distance between two travelers moving in opposite directions using the sum of their speeds.

capabilities.name: Solving simultaneous encounter motion problems
capabilities.name_zh: 相向而行的相遇行程问题（同时出发）
capabilities.description: Determine encounter time or initial distance between two travelers moving towards each other simultaneously using encounter distance / sum of speeds.

capabilities.name: Solving phased encounter motion problems with departure delays
capabilities.name_zh: 不同时出发的相遇行程问题
capabilities.description: Deduct the distance covered by the early traveler during head-start time before applying speed sum to the remaining gap.

capabilities.name: Calculating standard rectangle and square perimeters
capabilities.name_zh: 长方形与正方形的基础周长计算
capabilities.description: Calculate perimeter from side lengths, and conversely compute the side length or missing dimension given perimeter and one known side.

capabilities.name: Calculating composite perimeters via edge translation
capabilities.name_zh: 平移法求巧算不规则图形周长
capabilities.description: Translate recessed or protruding boundary line segments outward to transform stepped or notched shapes into standard bounding rectangles.

capabilities.name: Tracking perimeter changes through cutting and pasting
capabilities.name_zh: 图形切拼与重叠中的周长增减变化
capabilities.description: Calculate the increase in perimeter when making internal cuts and the reduction in perimeter when overlapping or joining shapes.

capabilities.name: Calculating standard rectangle and square areas
capabilities.name_zh: 长方形与正方形的基础面积计算与单位应用
capabilities.description: Calculate area using side length products, and determine missing dimensions from area values using inverse division.

capabilities.name: Splitting and completing composite rectilinear areas
capabilities.name_zh: 割补法与添补法求组合图形面积
capabilities.description: Calculate the area of L-shaped, T-shaped, or notched rectilinear figures by decomposing them into non-overlapping rectangles or subtracting external voids.

capabilities.name: Translating paths to evaluate remaining rectangular area
capabilities.name_zh: 平移道路求空白草坪/花圃面积
capabilities.description: Translate intersecting or traversing uniform pathways to the outer boundaries of a rectangular plot to calculate residual area in one product.

capabilities.name: Area relations in composite squares and triangles
capabilities.name_zh: 正方形组合与等积变形求阴影面积
capabilities.description: Compute the area of shaded triangles or quadrilaterals embedded within joined squares using trapezoid formulas or equal-area shearing along diagonals.

capabilities.name: Distinguishing between parallel and intersecting geometric lines
capabilities.name_zh: 平面直线的相交、平行与交点极值分析
capabilities.description: Determine how introducing new lines into a planar diagram alters the count of intersection points and regions, distinguishing parallel lines from concurrent intersections.

capabilities.name: Counting line segments systematically
capabilities.name_zh: 有序数线段（打枪法/公式法）
capabilities.description: Count all line segments along a partitioned straight line using endpoint pairing or consecutive index summation 1 + 2 + ... + n.

capabilities.name: Counting rectangles on standard and modified grids
capabilities.name_zh: 数方格网及特殊线段构成的长方形个数
capabilities.description: Count total rectangles on grid networks using horizontal and vertical segment combinations (m(m+1)/2 x n(n+1)/2) and account for added or deleted segments.

capabilities.name: Counting overlapping composite planar figures
capabilities.name_zh: 数重叠与交错组合图形
capabilities.description: Count squares, rectangles, or triangles spanning across intersecting large shapes using the principle of inclusion-exclusion on sub-regions.

capabilities.name: Applying the addition principle for disjoint classifications
capabilities.name_zh: 分类加法计数原理
capabilities.description: Partition problem outcomes into mutually exclusive categories and sum their individual counts to find the grand total.

capabilities.name: Applying the multiplication principle for multi-stage selection
capabilities.name_zh: 分步乘法计数原理（搭配问题）
capabilities.description: Break a complete task into independent consecutive stages (such as clothing outfits or meal combos) and multiply the options per stage.

capabilities.name: Selecting between addition and multiplication counting principles
capabilities.name_zh: 辨析并综合运用加乘原理
capabilities.description: Discern whether complex combinatorial choices require categorization (addition), staging (multiplication), or a nested combination of both.

capabilities.name: Shortest-path grid routing with obstacles
capabilities.name_zh: 标数法求最短路线（含障碍点）
capabilities.description: Label vertices with cumulative route counts from start to finish, treating obstructed vertices or streets as zero paths.

capabilities.name: Forming numbers under digit availability constraints
capabilities.name_zh: 有条件限制的组数问题
capabilities.description: Count multi-digit numbers that can be formed from given digit sets, enforcing rules on digit reuse, odd/even restrictions, or non-zero leading digits.

capabilities.name: Systematic integer partition via dictionary order
capabilities.name_zh: 字典排列法进行数的拆分
capabilities.description: Enumerate all ways to express an integer as the sum of a fixed number of positive or non-negative integers in strict non-decreasing order.

capabilities.name: Solving two-set inclusion-exclusion problems
capabilities.name_zh: 两集合容斥原理基础计算
capabilities.description: Calculate total population, intersection, or single-set quantities using Total = |A| + |B| - |A and B| + Neither.

capabilities.name: Solving three-set inclusion-exclusion problems
capabilities.name_zh: 三集合容斥原理图表与公式计算
capabilities.description: Determine unknown survey subsets across three overlapping categories using the three-set Venn formula or 7-region diagram filling.

capabilities.name: Converting between page numbers and total digit counts
capabilities.name_zh: 由页码总数求数字总个数及反求总页数
capabilities.description: Break page numbering into 1-digit (1-9), 2-digit (10-99), and 3-digit (100-n) intervals to calculate total digits written or deduce total pages from digit sums.

capabilities.name: Counting occurrences of a specific digit across page numbers
capabilities.name_zh: 页码中某个数字出现的频次统计
capabilities.description: Tally occurrences of a specific digit (e.g., how many times '8' appears) by analyzing units, tens, and hundreds places across page ranges.

capabilities.name: Applying the basic pigeonhole principle to guarantee identical properties
capabilities.name_zh: 基本抽屉原理与最不利原则
capabilities.description: Identify items and pigeonholes, compute quotient and remainder via n / k, and assert the guaranteed minimum number of items sharing an attribute.

capabilities.name: Solving addition and subtraction cryptarithms
capabilities.name_zh: 加减法竖式算式谜
capabilities.description: Determine hidden single digits represented by letters or geometric shapes in addition and subtraction column forms using carry/borrow constraints.

capabilities.name: Solving multi-digit multiplication cryptarithms
capabilities.name_zh: 乘法竖式算式谜
capabilities.description: Deduce unknown multiplicand and multiplier digits by combining end-digit multiplication results with leading-digit carry limits.

capabilities.name: Classifying graph vertices by parity of degree
capabilities.name_zh: 判断连通图顶点的奇偶性
capabilities.description: Count the number of edges incident to each vertex in a topological network and categorize vertices as odd or even nodes.

capabilities.name: Evaluating Eulerian traversability
capabilities.name_zh: 一笔画问题与欧拉路径判定
capabilities.description: Determine whether a connected network or bridge system can be traversed without retracing any edge by checking whether the number of odd vertices is 0 or 2.

capabilities.name: Solving grid deduction and Latin square puzzles
capabilities.name_zh: 数独与数阵图的行列不重复推理
capabilities.description: Fill missing symbols or numbers into 4x4 or 5x5 grids satisfying row, column, and block uniqueness alongside directional sightline constraints.

capabilities.name: Solving verbal logic matching puzzles using elimination grids
capabilities.name_zh: 列表排除法解逻辑推理问题
capabilities.description: Construct two-dimensional cross-reference tables (tick-and-cross grids) to systematically eliminate impossible pairings and deduce unique person-attribute matches.

capabilities.name: Solving discrete optimization and purchase packaging problems
capabilities.name_zh: 离散最优化与打包购买统筹策略
capabilities.description: Compare unit costs across different bundle sizes to identify greedy purchasing combinations that meet minimum quantity thresholds at lowest total expense.
